messages:
Lina: Kicking off AstraLens POC perf thread. Goal: show 2.5k sustained qps on /v1/generate (chat-ish), p99 < 200ms for short/med mix. They care about burst recovery and billing for burst minutes. Window request: Tue 09:00 PT, 90m.

Jake: I'll own the load harness and artifacts. Need exact token distribution and whether we should run both hosted and a short Dedicated fallback.

Lina: Payload mix: 75% short (~32 tokens), 20% medium (~140), 5% long (~380). Include 20% streaming calls to exercise SSE path. Test hosted first, fallback to dedicated only if we see saturation. Auth: API key for hosted run.

Marco: Ops note: staging pool has 4x A10G free. I can request 2 more for Tue slot; approval required. Private HSM requires ~48h for peering/import. Hosted KMS envelope is fine for this run.

Jake: Proposed mini-plan:
- Ramp 0->2.5k over 12m, hold 30m steady
- Burst recovery: three 20s spikes to 7.5k qps with 2m recoveries
- Cache warmup: spawn 8k new sessions over 10m
I'll use vegeta for open-loop qps and a tiny Locust suite for streaming.

Jake: Example vegeta command we'll include in repo:
```
echo "POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate" > targets.txt
vegeta attack -rate=2500 -duration=30m -targets=targets.txt | vegeta report
```
We'll tag with X-Run-ID and X-Trace for tracing alignment.

Lina: Acceptance: p99(short+med) <=200ms in steady, error rate <0.5%, tail recovery <90s after bursts. Collect p50/p90/p99, errors, token cost, per-shard GPU util.

security: Heads up on questionnaire items: BYOK/HSM, KMS envelope flow, audit log retention, and SOC2. If they require HSM import we'll need 48h+ lead time and a short network diagram.

Marco: Reservation request submitted for +2 A10G Tue 07:30-11:30 PT. Pending capacity. I'll enable kernel tracing for the window.

Jake: I'll push the runbook + scripts to perf/astral-run and drop link here when ready. Also preparing a token->cost quicksheet to show hosted vs Dedicated commit.

Lina: Perfect. React with :white_check_mark: when done. We'll post pre-run checklist 24h prior.

Jake: :white_check_mark: initial scripts pushed, validating prompt mix now.

Marco: :white_check_mark: reservation pending accepted, will confirm shortly.

security: :white_check_mark: security draft sent to sales for review.
